id: title:LeonardoRosaa:preserve dashboard context after discarding overrides

review.posthog_relevance: Preserves dashboard context when editing insights, potentially retaining dashboard-specific filters or settings.
review.reason: The change is a narrow, localized behavior correction and implementation. P1.F1.H1 demonstrates the implementation of passing `dashboardId` into the insight view URL, while P1.F2.H1 provides a corresponding test assertion. This preserves dashboard context during insight editing, a bounded capability. No systemic risk reduction or broader capability is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that retaining dashboard context is valuable, which is not independently verified by the code alone; the change could be irrelevant if dashboard-specific filters are not shared or preserved in this manner.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 are supplied; no other hunks are available. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: The InsightSceneHeader now passes dashboardId into urls.insightView, changing the generated URL to include the dashboard context.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users to edit a saved insight while retaining the dashboard context, rather than navigating to a standalone insight view. This could preserve dashboard-specific filters or settings when editing an insight that was originally created within a dashboard.

observations.behavior: Adds an assertion that the URL contains the dashboardId parameter after editing a funnel insight.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the URL correctly preserves the dashboard context after an edit operation, supporting the behavior change in P1.F1.H1.
